data.description: The bastion of China, Sage creates safety for herself and her team wherever she goes. Able to revive fallen friends and stave off forceful assaults, she provides a calm center to a hellish battlefield.

role.description: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

abilities.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Slow Orb</>. FIRE to throw. On landing, create a zone that <debuffred>slows</> all players and plays an audio cue when enemies run through it.
EQUIP <whitebold>Healing Orb</>. FIRE on a damaged ally to grant <teal>healing</>. ALT FIRE to self-cast.
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Barrier Orb</>. While equipped, REACTIVATE to pivot the wall or HOLD ALT FIRE to rotate. FIRE to place a destructible wall that fortifies after a delay.
EQUIP <whitebold>Resurrection</>. FIRE on a targeted dead ally to <teal>resurrect</> them.

data.description: Forged in the heart of Mexico, Reyna dominates single combat, popping off with each kill she scores. Her capability is only limited by her raw skill, making her sharply dependent on performance.

role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.description:
INSTANTLY consume a <whitebold>Soul Orb</> to <teal>heal</>. Excess healing is converted into <teal>overheal</>.

While ULTIMATE is active, <whitebold>Devour</> auto-casts.

INSTANTLY consume a <whitebold>Soul Orb</> to briefly become <teal>intangible</>. REACTIVATE to cancel early.

While ULTIMATE is active, also gain <teal>invisibility</>.
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Leer</>. FIRE to send. After a delay, form, <debuffred>nearsighting</> enemies looking at it.

INSTANTLY gain <teal>Empress</>.

<teal>Empress</> grants <teal>combat stim</>, endless <whitebold>Soul Orb</> consumption, and permanent <teal>overheal</>.
Spawn a <whitebold>Soul Orb</> from dead enemies Reyna has damaged or killed.

data.description: A phantom of a memory, Omen hunts in the shadows. He renders enemies blind, teleports across the field, then lets paranoia take hold as his foe scrambles to uncover where he might strike next.

role.description: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.

abilities.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Paranoia</>. FIRE to send it forward. Applies <debuffred>nearsight</> and <debuffred>deafens</> all players.
ENTER Shadow Vision. REACTIVATE to cast a smoke. HOLD FIRE/ALT FIRE to adjust distance. RELOAD to toggle view.
EQUIP a <whitebold>Shrouded Step</>. FIRE to briefly channel, then teleport to a targeted location.
EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to begin a teleport to a selected location. While teleporting, Omen appears as a destructible shade at the destination. REACTIVATE to cancel.

data.description: Representing her home country of South Korea, Jett's agile and evasive fighting style lets her take risks no one else can. She runs circles around every skirmish, cutting enemies up before they even know what hit them.

role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.description: INSTANTLY propel high into the air.

INSTANTLY prepare a dash. REACTIVATE to dash forward or in your movement direction.

Resets every two kills.
INSTANTLY throw a cloud. Forms into a brief smoke on any surface or after a delay. HOLD ACTIVATE to steer towards your crosshair.

INSTANTLY access five accurate throwing knives that deal <debuffred>lethal damage</> with direct hits to the head.

FIRE to shoot. On kills, refresh your knives. ALT FIRE to throw all remaining knives without a refresh.
HOLD JUMP while falling to <teal>glide</>.
